text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 209 tablets of divalproex sodium 500 mg with daily use of 8.1 tablets, providing 25.7 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows divalproex sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The product label for NDC 67046164703 names Coupler LLC as the registered repack plant (FEI 3003734940). Coupler LLC's most recent FDA inspection ended 2026-03-02 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 26 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list. The repack plant has an acceptable inspection classification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Atlantic Biologicals Corp. as first alternate source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with AbbVie Inc. as second alternate source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as third alternate source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Aurobindo Pharma Limited as fourth alternate source; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with AvPAK as fifth alternate source; requires buyer approval.
6. Buyer to monitor inventory daily and report to P&T committee if days on hand fall below 14; requires P&T committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
